scripts.dev: pnpm db:setup:local && wrangler dev --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.dev:preview: pnpm db:setup:local && wrangler dev --env preview --port ${AECI_API_PORT:-8787} --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy: wrangler deploy --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:staging: wrangler deploy --env staging --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:demo: wrangler deploy --env demo --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.deploy:production: wrangler deploy --env production --var COMMIT_SHA:$(git rev-parse HEAD) --var DEPLOYED_AT:$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z)
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm db:seed:taxonomy:local && pnpm db:seed:data-objects:local && pnpm db:seed:catalog:local && pnpm db:seed:fixtures:local && pnpm db:seed:auth:local
